scope: Cook, researcher and guard only; mechanic is authored separately by root.
direction: Follow the original scout/medic quiet trouser contours, small rounded shoes and modest three-quarter side pose. Reduce exaggerated knees, ankle folds, boot soles and wide stance. Preserve head/clothing identity and role props. Judge visually, not by a target width-height ratio.
sourcePixels: Native generated PNGs copied unchanged. No cropping, recoloring, resampling or programmatic background removal. V1/V2 sources remain preserved.

assets.prompt: Edit Image1, the cook body silhouette. Image2 and Image3 are the original scout and medic, the mandatory visual proportion and pose references. Keep this character's identity: Preserve her tied bun, swept fringe, jacket hood and apron hem. Keep the hands resting beside her hips. She remains the same woman cook. Correct the over-exaggerated body contour of Image1 so this adult survivor belongs beside Image2/3. Turn the torso slightly more toward screen right, into the same modest three-quarter side stance as the references, rather than a square frontal pose. Use a relaxed everyday jacket silhouette, simple trouser legs with quiet nearly straight contours, and small plain rounded closed shoes. Remove the inflated knee bulges, stacked ankle folds, bulky mitten-like cuffs, exaggerated boot soles, flared feet and overly wide stance from Image1. Feet should sit naturally under the body with a modest gap and only a subtle step offset. Keep comfortable body volume and normal adult survivor proportions; do not turn the character into a skinny figure or elongate the legs. The head identity, clothing identity and role prop must remain recognizable; express them only through the outer contour. Draw one consistent flat black #171b1a silhouette with NO facial details, interior lines, highlights, garment texture or shading. Whole character from hair/cap top to both shoe soles visible, with hands and prop entirely included. Never crop any part of the body. No paper border, no outline, no base, no pedestal, no floor and no shadow. The output must be an actual transparent-background PNG, with zero-alpha empty space. One individual native high-resolution full-body image, as large as the tool can natively generate; ideally the visible figure is at least 1536 pixels tall. Do not upscale or horizontally stretch the old image.
